name: Thistleshrub Valley
summary: In southwestern Tanaris, giant cacti and living thistleshrubs crowd a canyon. The hostile plants lash out at travelers who cross their thorn-choked ground.

sections.title: A Grove of Thorns
sections.body: Giant blooming cacti rise above the sand, crowding a canyon where much of Tanaris lies bare. Living thistleshrubs give the valley its name. They strike travelers who come near with sharp spines, making the crossing perilous. Their thorny brush blocks the way past the cliffs toward the mysterious southern gates.

sections.title: Sentinels of the Desert
sections.body: Travelers have long wondered how animated plants survive in such a dry land. The thistleshrubs fiercely guard their ground. Forgotten elemental energies may have awakened them, or they may have adapted to Tanaris's harsh climate. Towering cacti offer little cover from desert predators and venomous serpents in the canyon.

faq.answer: Thistleshrub Valley lies in southwestern Tanaris, along the southern mountain ridge near the mysterious sealed gates of Uldum.

faq.q: Why is there so much plant life in this part of Tanaris?
faq.answer: Unlike the barren desert around it, the valley shelters towering cacti and animated plants. How the thistleshrubs thrive so fiercely in dry sand remains a mystery of the southern dunes.

faq.q: What creatures live in Thistleshrub Valley?
faq.answer: Hostile walking thistleshrubs, aggressive desert blooms and venomous reptiles live in the valley, hidden among thorny plants.

faq.q: What is the massive stone structure near the valley?
faq.answer: A massive sealed Titan structure stands just beyond the valley. Desert wanderers call it the gateway to Uldum, though it remains locked and enigmatic.

angles.text: For herbalists crossing Tanaris, the valley holds unusual, resilient plants among thick groves of thorny brush.
As a druid, you may find the viciously animated thistleshrubs fascinating. You may wonder what primeval or elemental forces keep them thriving in this desolate desert.
